title: Add Mikey Mouse: side-button navigation and smooth wheel scrolling
paragraphs: A menu-bar replacement for the two Mac Mouse Fix features in use, now that its trial has ended.

Side buttons 4 and 5 become the trackpad "swipe between pages" gesture in apps that ignore them (every com.apple.* app, ForkLift, Firefox, Opera). Chrome, VS Code and other apps that already handle the buttons keep the raw click. The swipe fields and the app list follow LinearMouse (MIT).

Each notch of a line-based wheel is swallowed and replayed as 120 Hz continuous pixel scrolls that ease out, with tick-rate acceleration up to 5x. Trackpads, the Magic Mouse and modifier scrolls pass through untouched.
The event tap runs at the HID level on its own thread. Verified on the Razer DeathAdder V3: back/forward in Finder and smooth scrolling both work, and the Accessibility grant survived a rebuild.
